name: Input Validation and Sanitization
description: Validate, sanitize, and constrain all inputs to AI components including prompts, tool arguments, and retrieved content to prevent injection and malformed data.

frameworkRefs.name: AI system security and resilience are evaluated and documented
Data-at-rest is protected

name: Output Filtering and Sanitization
description: Filter, validate, and sanitize all model outputs before they are returned to users or passed to downstream systems to prevent data leakage and harmful content.

frameworkRefs.name: AI system security and resilience are evaluated and documented

name: Access Control and RBAC
description: Enforce role-based access control on AI components, tool connectors, data sources, and model endpoints to ensure least-privilege access.

frameworkRefs.name: Identities and credentials are managed
Risk management process established through transparent policies and procedures

name: Human-in-the-Loop Approval
description: Require human review and approval for high-impact actions initiated by AI agents, including data modifications, financial transactions, and external communications.

frameworkRefs.name: Processes for human oversight are defined, assessed, and documented

name: Rate Limiting and Resource Management
description: Apply rate limiting, request throttling, and resource quotas to model inference endpoints and AI-facing APIs to prevent denial of service and model extraction.

frameworkRefs.name: Resource capacity to ensure availability is maintained

name: Data Classification and Handling
description: Classify all data flowing through AI systems and enforce handling controls appropriate to each classification level, including masking, redaction, and access restrictions.

frameworkRefs.name: Data-at-rest is protected
Responses to high-priority AI risks are developed, planned, and documented

name: Model Provenance and Integrity Verification
description: Verify the provenance, integrity, and authenticity of models, weights, and dependencies before deployment. Maintain a model bill-of-materials.

frameworkRefs.name: Pre-trained models used for development are monitored
Authenticity and integrity of hardware and software are assessed before use

name: Monitoring and Anomaly Detection
description: Continuously monitor AI system behavior, inputs, outputs, and performance for anomalies, drift, misuse, and security events. Alert on suspicious patterns.

frameworkRefs.name: Computing hardware, software, and runtime are monitored
Post-deployment AI system monitoring plans are implemented

name: Encryption in Transit and at Rest
description: Encrypt all data in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest, including model weights, embeddings, training data, and inference payloads.

frameworkRefs.name: Data-in-transit is protected
Data-at-rest is protected

name: Guardrail and Safety Filter Deployment
description: Deploy input and output guardrails, content safety filters, and moderation layers to enforce policy constraints on AI system interactions.

frameworkRefs.name: AI system security and resilience are evaluated and documented

name: Output Encoding for Downstream Consumers
description: Apply context-appropriate output encoding, escaping, and validation to model output before it is consumed by interpreters, executors, query engines, or rendering layers.

frameworkRefs.name: Data-at-rest is protected
AI system security and resilience are evaluated and documented

name: System Prompt Hardening and Secret Externalization
description: Keep secrets and sensitive logic out of system prompts, apply prompt-hardening, and enforce security controls outside the prompt rather than relying on its confidentiality.

frameworkRefs.name: System requirements are elicited and documented

name: Output Grounding and Verification
description: Constrain responses to verified sources, attach citations, apply retrieval grounding, and require human verification for high-stakes outputs.

frameworkRefs.name: The AI system is demonstrated to be valid and reliable
